# Importation de la base d'indice de production du gaz et électricité de 2003 à 2022
```{r}
library(forecast)
library(readxl)
library(tsoutliers)
library(psych)
library(tidyverse)
library(TSA)
library(seastests)
library(RJDemetra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo) 
library(smooth)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
base <- read_excel("IPG2211A2N (1).xlsx", 
    sheet = "Monthly")
```
# Analyse exploratoire

## Présentation de la série 
```{r}
xx <- ts(data = base[,2], start=c(2003,01),frequency=12)
plot(xx, main ="Gaz et Electricité de 2003 à 2022 ")
```
```{r}

# Distribution, ACF et PACF
ggtsdisplay(xx, plot.type="histogram")

# Effets saisonniers
ggseasonplot(xx, col=rainbow(12), year.labels=TRUE)
```

## Détection des poins atypiques
```{r}
fit <- tso(xx)
plot(fit) 
show(fit)
```
4 points atypiques dont un TC et 3 AO.

```{r}
xx_c <- fit$yadj
plot(xx_c)
#write(t(xx_c),file="adjusted-outlier-serie.out",ncolumn=1,append=FALSE)
```


##Statistique descriptive
```{r}
describe(xx_c)
```


Les points atypiques détectés sont significatifs (|t-stat| > 3), ce qui justifie leur correction.
```{r}
boxplot(xx_c, main="Boxplot de la série corrigée", ylab="IPG", col="darkblue")
```


## Détection de la saisonnalité
```{r}
dxx_c <- diff(xx_c, differences = 1)
```

```{r}
# Correlogramme
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
acf(xx_c, main="Série en niveau")
acf(dxx_c, main="Série différenciée")
```
On voit bien de la saisonnalité (des pics très fort et très bas, 12)


```{r}
## Periodogramme
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
periodogram(xx_c, main="la série en niveau")
periodogram(dxx_c, main="la série en différence première")

```

```{r}
sd <- seasdum(xx_c)

```

# Prévision de la série saisonnière
## Estimation et prévision.

### Naive, X13-SARIMA-SEATS, STL et STS

#### Les méthodes naives

```{r}
prevsnaive <- snaive(xx_c,h=12)
prevsnaive
plot(snaive(xx_c,h=12))
```

#### X13 SARIMA-SEATS
```{r}
#X13-arima-seats
library(RJDemetra)
myregx13 <- regarima_x13(xx_c, spec ="RG5c")
summary (myregx13)
# Forecast of the original series (fcst) and it's standard error (fcsterr) for 2 years
prevx13 <- myregx13$forecast
prevx13 <- prevx13[, "fcst"]

# Only forecasts for 2 years
forex13 <- matrix(myregx13$forecast[1:12])
(forex13)
```
Nous rappelons que c'est un modèle arima (2,0,1)(0,1,1) qui a une transformation log.
aic :1090

```{r}
summary(myregx13)
```

```{r}
AIC_x13  <- 1090
AICc_x13 <-1090
```

#### STL
```{r}
fitstl <- stlm(xx_c)
fitstl$model
```
On a un ETS(A,N,N) modèle avec erreur additive pas de tendance ni saisonnalité.
aic: 1738

```{r}
#décomposition
xstl <- ts(data = xx_c[1:240,1],frequency=12)
decomp <- stl(xstl, s.window="periodic")
#plot(decomp)

##prévision avec sl
fitstl = stlm(xstl)
prevstl <- forecast(fitstl,12)
show(prevstl)
plot(prevstl)
```
```{r}
AIC_stl <- AIC(fitstl$model)

n_stl <- length(xx_c)
k_stl <- length(coef(fitstl$model))

AICc_stl <- AIC_stl + (2 * k_stl * (k_stl + 1)) / (n_stl - k_stl - 1)
```

#### STS

```{r}
# dévcomposition
fitsts <- StructTS(xx_c)
#plot(cbind(fitted(fitsts), residuals(fitsts)))
#summary(fitsts)
show(fitsts)
#prévision
prevsts<-forecast(fitsts, 12)
show(prevsts)
plot(prevsts)
```
On a ajusté un modèle BSM avec level, slope, seas, et epsilonLa variance de la série en niveau est élévée, donc change de niveau, cependant la pente est constante avec une saisonnalité significative et pas de bruit blanc.

```{r}
loglik_sts <- fitsts$loglik
k_sts <- length(fitsts$coef)

AIC_sts <- -2 * loglik_sts + 2 * k_sts
n <- length(xx_c)
k <- length(fitsts$coef)

AICc_sts <- AIC_sts + (2*k*(k+1))/(n-k-1)
```

#### Résumé sous forme de tableau (mieux à faire avec excel)
en terme d'ajustement les modèles issus de SARIMA et x13- ARIMA SEAT l'emporte
```{r}


#-----------------------------
# 1. Fonction utilitaire
#-----------------------------
to_param_df <- function(model_name, params) {
data.frame(
Parametre = names(params),
Valeur = as.character(params),
Modele = model_name,
stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
}

#-----------------------------
# 2. X13
#-----------------------------
extract_x13 <- function(myregx13, AIC_x13 = NA, AICc_x13 = NA) {
  s <- capture.output(summary(myregx13))
  
  # Si les coeffs ne sont pas facilement extractibles de l'objet,
  # on les récupère depuis le résumé texte.
  params <- c(
    transformation = if (any(grepl("Log-transformation: yes", s))) "log" else "level",
    AIC = AIC_x13,
    AICc = AICc_x13
  )
  
  # Tentative d'extraction automatique via le texte
  get_coef <- function(pattern, label) {
    line <- s[grepl(pattern, s)]
    if (length(line) == 0) return(NULL)
    val <- sub("^.*?(-?[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*$", "\\1", trimws(line[1]))
    setNames(val, label)
  }
  
  coefs <- c(
    get_coef("^Phi\\(1\\)", "ar1"),
    get_coef("^Phi\\(2\\)", "ar2"),
    get_coef("^Phi\\(3\\)", "ar3"),
    get_coef("^Theta\\(1\\)", "ma1"),
    get_coef("^Theta\\(2\\)", "ma2"),
    get_coef("^Theta\\(3\\)", "ma3"),
    get_coef("^BPhi\\(1\\)|^SPhi\\(1\\)", "sar1"),
    get_coef("^BPhi\\(2\\)|^SPhi\\(2\\)", "sar2"),
    get_coef("^BTheta\\(1\\)|^STheta\\(1\\)", "sma1"),
    get_coef("^BTheta\\(2\\)|^STheta\\(2\\)", "sma2")
  )
  
  params <- c(coefs, params)
  to_param_df("X13", params)
}

#-----------------------------
# 3. STL + ETS
#-----------------------------
extract_stl_ets <- function(fitstl) {
  m <- fitstl$model
  
  params <- c()
  
  # paramètre alpha/beta/gamma/phi si présents
  if (!is.null(m$par)) {
    params <- c(params, m$par)
  }
  
  # type ETS
  ets_type <- tryCatch(m$method, error = function(e) NA)
  if (is.null(ets_type)) ets_type <- NA
  
  # AIC / AICc / BIC si présents
  if (!is.null(m$aic))  params <- c(params, AIC = m$aic)
  if (!is.null(m$aicc)) params <- c(params, AICc = m$aicc)
  if (!is.null(m$bic))  params <- c(params, BIC = m$bic)
  
  params <- c(params, modele = ets_type)
  to_param_df("STL", params)
}

#-----------------------------
# 4. STS
#-----------------------------
extract_sts <- function(fitsts, n_obs) {
  params <- fitsts$coef
  
  # AIC manuel
  k <- length(fitsts$coef)
  AIC_sts <- -2 * fitsts$loglik + 2 * k
  AICc_sts <- AIC_sts + (2 * k * (k + 1)) / (n_obs - k - 1)
  
  params <- c(params, AIC = AIC_sts, AICc = AICc_sts)
  to_param_df("STS", params)
}

#-----------------------------
# 5. Naive / SNaive
#-----------------------------
extract_snaive <- function() {
params <- c(modele = "Saisonnier lag 12")
to_param_df("SNaive", params)
}


#-----------------------------
# 6. Construction du tableau
#-----------------------------
tab_long <- bind_rows(
  extract_snaive(),
  extract_x13(myregx13, AIC_x13 = 1090, AICc_x13 = 1090),
  extract_stl_ets(fitstl),
  extract_sts(fitsts, n_obs = length(xx_c))
)

tableau_final <- tab_long %>%
  distinct(Modele, Parametre, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Modele, values_from = Valeur)

tableau_final
```

### Qualité de prévision

#### Séparation en train test
```{r}
train <- window(xx_c, end = c(2021,12))
test  <- window(xx_c, start = c(2022,1))
```

```{r}
h <- length(test)

# 1. SNaive
fit_snaive <- snaive(train, h = h)
fc_snaive  <- fit_snaive

# 2. STL
fit_stl <- stlm(train, s.window = "periodic", method = "ets")
fc_stl  <- forecast(fit_stl, h = h)

# 3. STS
fit_sts <- StructTS(train)
fc_sts  <- forecast(fit_sts, h = h)

# 4. Holt-Winters
fit_hw <- HoltWinters(train)
fc_hw  <- forecast(fit_hw, h = h)

# 5. ETS
fit_ets <- ets(train)
fc_ets  <- forecast(fit_ets, h = h)

# 6. TBATS
fit_tbats <- tbats(train)
fc_tbats  <- forecast(fit_tbats, h = h)

# 7. SARIMA
fit_sarima <- auto.arima(train, seasonal = TRUE)
fc_sarima  <- forecast(fit_sarima, h = h)

# 8. SSARIMA
fit_ssarima <- auto.ssarima(
  train,
  lags = c(1, 12),
  orders = list(ar = c(3,3), i = 2, ma = c(3,3), select = TRUE)
)
fc_ssarima <- forecast(fit_ssarima, h = h)

# 9. ADAM ETS
fit_adam_ets <- auto.adam(train, model="ZZZ", lags=c(1,12), select=TRUE)
fc_adam_ets  <- forecast(fit_adam_ets, h = h)

# 10. ADAM ETS+ARIMA
fit_adam_ets_arima <- auto.adam(train, model="ZZZ", lags=c(1,1,12), orders=list(ar=c(3,3), i=(2), ma=c(3,3), select=TRUE))
fc_adam_ets_arima  <- forecast(fit_adam_ets_arima, h = h)

# 11. 
```

```{r}
# Estimation sur train
fit_x13 <- regarima_x13(train, spec = "RG5c")

# Prévisions
fc_x13 <- fit_x13$forecast[1:h]

# Transformer en ts aligné sur test
fc_x13 <- ts(fc_x13, start = start(test), frequency = frequency(test))
```

```{r}
calc_errors <- function(real, pred) {
  e <- real - pred
  
  mse <- mean(e^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  medse <- median(e^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  return(c(MSE = mse, MedSE = medse))
}
```

#### Benchmark naif
```{r}
fc_snaive_bench <- snaive(train, h = h)
err_snaive_bench <- calc_errors(test, fc_snaive_bench$mean)
mse_snaive_bench <- err_snaive_bench["MSE"]
```

#### calculs des erreurs
```{r}
# erreurs
err_arima <- calc_errors(test, fc_sarima$mean)
err_ets   <- calc_errors(test, fc_ets$mean)
err_hw    <- calc_errors(test, fc_hw$mean)
err_sts   <- calc_errors(test, fc_sts$mean)
err_tbats <- calc_errors(test, fc_tbats$mean)

# R2 OOS
R2_arima <- 1 - err_arima["MSE"] / err_snaive_bench["MSE"]
R2_ets   <- 1 - err_ets["MSE"]   / err_snaive_bench["MSE"]
R2_hw    <- 1 - err_hw["MSE"]    / err_snaive_bench["MSE"]
R2_sts   <- 1 - err_sts["MSE"]   / err_snaive_bench["MSE"]
R2_tbats <- 1 - err_tbats["MSE"] / err_snaive_bench["MSE"]
```


#### R² OUT-OF-SAMPLE

```{r}
results <- data.frame(
  Modele = character(),
  MSE = numeric(),
  MedSE = numeric(),
  R2OOS = numeric()
)

ajout_resultat <- function(nom, pred) {
  err <- calc_errors(test, pred)
  data.frame(
    Modele = nom,
    MSE = err["MSE"],
    MedSE = err["MedSE"],
    R2OOS = 1 - err["MSE"] / mse_snaive_bench
  )
}

results <- rbind(
  results,
  ajout_resultat("STL", fc_stl$mean),
  ajout_resultat("STS", fc_sts$mean),
  ajout_resultat("Holt-Winters", fc_hw$mean),
  ajout_resultat("ETS", fc_ets$mean),
  ajout_resultat("TBATS", fc_tbats$mean),
  ajout_resultat("SARIMA", fc_sarima$mean),
  ajout_resultat("SSARIMA", fc_ssarima$mean),
  ajout_resultat("X13", fc_x13),
  ajout_resultat("ADAM ETS", fc_adam_ets$mean),
  ajout_resultat("ADAM ETS+ARIMA", fc_adam_ets_arima$mean),
  data.frame(
    Modele = "Benchmark SNaive",
    MSE = mse_snaive_bench,
    MedSE = err_snaive_bench["MedSE"],
    R2OOS = 0
  )
)

results <- results[order(results$MSE), ]
results
```
ETS a le plus petit MSE et Holt le plus petit MedSE et  le R2OOS positif traduisant que tous les modèles sont mieux que le naif.

#### CSPE

```{r}
# observations réelles
obs <- as.numeric(test)

# dates du test
dates <- seq(as.Date("2022-01-01"), by = "month", length.out = length(test))

# tableau des prévisions
df_forecasts <- data.frame(
  Date = dates,
  SNaive = as.numeric(fc_snaive$mean),
  STL = as.numeric(fc_stl$mean),
  STS = as.numeric(fc_sts$mean),
  `Holt-Winters` = as.numeric(fc_hw$mean),
  ETS = as.numeric(fc_ets$mean),
  TBATS = as.numeric(fc_tbats$mean),
  SARIMA = as.numeric(fc_sarima$mean),
  SSARIMA = as.numeric(fc_ssarima$mean),
  `ADAM ETS` = as.numeric(fc_adam_ets$mean),
  `ADAM ETS+ARIMA` = as.numeric(fc_adam_ets_arima$mean),
  X13 = as.numeric(fc_x13),
  Realisee = obs
)

# prévisions seules
previsions <- df_forecasts |> select(-Date, -Realisee)

# CSPE brut pour chaque modèle
cspe_df <- map_dfc(previsions, ~ cumsum((obs - .x)^2)) |>
  mutate(Date = dates) |>
  pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "Modele", values_to = "CSPE")

# graphique
ggplot(cspe_df, aes(x = Date, y = CSPE, color = Modele)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Erreur quadratique cumulative (CSPE) par modèle",
    x = NULL,
    y = "CSPE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

On garde ETS

```{r}
# tableau des prévisions
```

###Diebold Mariano en comparant à AR(1)

```{r}
# modèle AR(1)
fit_ar1 <- Arima(train, order = c(1,0,0))
fc_ar1  <- forecast(fit_ar1, h = h)
```

```{r}

dm_test_model <- function(real, pred_model, pred_ar1) {
  dm.test(
    e1 = real - pred_model,
    e2 = real - pred_ar1,
    alternative = "less",   # ton modèle meilleur
    h = 1,
    power = 2
  )
}
```


```{r}
dm_results <- list()

dm_results$ETS <- dm_test_model(test, fc_ets$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$HW  <- dm_test_model(test, fc_hw$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$STS <- dm_test_model(test, fc_sts$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$TBATS <- dm_test_model(test, fc_tbats$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$SARIMA <- dm_test_model(test, fc_sarima$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$SSARIMA <- dm_test_model(test, fc_ssarima$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$STL <- dm_test_model(test, fc_stl$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$SNaive <- dm_test_model(test, fc_snaive$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$X13 <- dm_test_model(test, fc_x13, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$ADAM_ETS <- dm_test_model(test, fc_adam_ets$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
dm_results$ADAM_ETS_ARIMA <- dm_test_model(test, fc_adam_ets_arima$mean, fc_ar1$mean)
```



```{r}
# Création du tableau final avec conclusion
dm_table_final <- data.frame(
  Modele = names(dm_results),
  Statistique_DM = sapply(dm_results, function(x) round(x$statistic, 3)),
  p_value = sapply(dm_results, function(x) round(x$p.value, 4))
)

# Affichage
print(dm_table_final)
```


Tous les modèles sont mieux que AR(1)
